description_en: Creates an API key for a model creation operator
description_zh: 创建模型算子 API KEY
name: CreateModelOperatorApiKey

parameters.help_en: The description. It cannot contain spaces and must not exceed 256 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 描述信息。不允许空格，且不能超过256字符
parameters.name: description

Status.description_en: The acceptance status of the creation request. If the request is successfully accepted, the value is always Creating, which does not indicate that the API key is available. Call DescribeModelOperatorApiKey or ListModelOperatorApiKeys to query the subsequent status. You can obtain the endpoint only when the status is Running, and obtain the plaintext key by calling DescribeModelOperatorApiKey. Each call to this operation creates a new API key. Do not repeatedly call this operation to check the progress
Status.description_zh: 创建请求的受理状态。成功受理时固定返回 Creating（创建中），不表示 API Key 已可用。请调用 DescribeModelOperatorApiKey 或 ListModelOperatorApiKeys 查询后续状态。仅 Running 状态可获取调用地址，通过 DescribeModelOperatorApiKey 获取明文 Key。每次调用本接口都会创建新的 API Key，请勿通过重复创建来查询进度
